package demo

import groovy.transform.CompileStatic

/* Block comment */
@CompileStatic
class Greeter {
    String name = 'world'

    String greet(int times = 1) {
        def text = "Hello, ${name}! $times\n"
        def raw = 'single $not'
        def multi = """
            Multi ${name.toUpperCase()}
        """
        def pattern = /\d+ "quoted"/
        def list = [1, 2, 3].collect { it * 2 }
        def map = [a: 1, b: 2.5]
        assert list.size() == 3
        return text * times + raw + multi
    }
}

def g = new Greeter(name: 'groovy')
println g.greet(2) + 0x1F + 1_000L + true + null
